title: Parser remains live before completion
statement: For Boolean words $b_s,\alpha,x$, at every natural-number time $s<4|b_s|+2|\alpha|+6$, the prefix parser on $\langle\langle b_s,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$ has not halted.
hypotheses_covered: Natural-number time $s$ is strictly less than $4|b_s|+2|\alpha|+6$
replaced:
At every time strictly before $4|b| + 2|\alpha| + 6$ steps on the nested pair
encoding $\langle \langle b, \alpha\rangle, x\rangle$, the prefix parser has
not halted.
